command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$pairs=@('CampusNetwork_02||CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_03||CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_04||CampusNetwork_05'); `$nodes=@('AGG_SW_01','AGG_SW_02','AGG_SW_03','AGG_SW_04','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02','PE1','PE2','PE3','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','SH_AR','SZ_AR','SH_Core','SZ_Core'); foreach(`$pair in `$pairs){ `$pa=`$pair -split '\|\|' | Select-Object -First 1; `$pb=`$pair -split '\|\|' | Select-Object -Last 1; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$ua='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$pa+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$ra=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$ua; `$ub='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$pb+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$rb=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$ub; if(`$ra.output -like 'Error:*'){ `$ua='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$pa+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=show%20running-config'; `$ra=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$ua }; if(`$rb.output -like 'Error:*'){ `$ub='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$pb+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=show%20running-config'; `$rb=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$ub }; if(`$ra.output -notlike 'Error:*' -and `$rb.output -notlike 'Error:*'){ `$oa=`$ra.output -split '\r?\n' | ForEach-Object { `$_.Trim() } | Where-Object { `$_ -and `$_ -notmatch '(?i)^Last configuration|^Current configuration|^!Time:|^snmp.*engineid|^username admin password|^crypto pki' }; `$ob=`$rb.output -split '\r?\n' | ForEach-Object { `$_.Trim() } | Where-Object { `$_ -and `$_ -notmatch '(?i)^Last configuration|^Current configuration|^!Time:|^snmp.*engineid|^username admin password|^crypto pki' }; `$d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$oa -DifferenceObject `$ob | Where-Object { `$_.InputObject -match '(?i)^ip route|^ip route-static|^static-lsp|vrrp|stp |shutdown|mtu|bandwidth|traffic|qos|track|prefix-list|^interface|port.*vlan|allow-pass vlan' }; if(`$d){ '### '+`$pb+' vs '+`$pa+' '+`$n; `$d | ForEach-Object { `$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject } } } } }"
